$comment: Golden conversation for the HelloCamera phone-client conformance kit. Meta-format: docs/conformance/README.md. invalid conversations carry a 'rejection' block naming the executable checker.
title: A non-increasing stateRevision is rejected; the last valid projection is retained

rejection.rule: A snapshot applies only when sessionId matches and stateRevision is strictly greater than the last applied revision. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §6)
rejection.effect: The phone retains the last valid projection (revision 7) and ignores the equal-revision snapshot. No lane changes.

summary: After a valid revision-7 snapshot, the desktop sends another revision-7 snapshot. The phone MUST NOT apply it; the last valid projection and revision remain unchanged.

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

instruction.text: Photographer: move one step to your left.

steps.note: Valid revision-7 snapshot is admitted; last applied revision becomes 7.

message.acceptedIntention: A confident full-body portrait at sunset

steps.note: stateRevision 7 is not strictly greater than the last applied revision 7. The phone rejects the whole snapshot and retains revision 7's projection. (PROTOCOL_V2.md §6)

outcome: Last valid projection (revision 7) retained. The phone MUST NOT apply the equal-revision snapshot regardless of its lane contents.
